details.name: Isolde Reyes
details.looks: Adult female, Latina, sun-kissed skin with faint laugh lines around warm amber eyes, tousled dark brown hair with a few simple woven beads.
details.wearing: Flowy, off-the-shoulder crimson top in a light, breathable fabric. Distressed denim shorts. Multiple thin silver bangles on each wrist.
details.face: Warm amber eyes are framed by faint laugh lines at the corners. The nose is straight, and the lips are slightly parted in a subtle smile. The skin is sun-kissed with a smooth texture and a few scattered freckles across the bridge of the nose.
details.body: The visible portion of the body suggests a slender to average build. The shoulders are bare, and the posture appears relaxed.
details.hair: The hair is dark brown, with a medium to long length. It is styled loosely, appearing somewhat tousled and natural, with a few small, woven beads interspersed within.
details.style: Her aesthetic is one of effortless bohemian charm, favoring natural fabrics and a palette that reflects the warm hues of sun and earth. Silhouettes are generally relaxed and flowing, though she can adapt to more structured elements with an innate sense of balance. Her style communicates a spirit of freedom and an appreciation for the simple, tangible beauty of the world.
details.personality: Warm, approachable, free-spirited, seems at ease.
details.voice: Her voice carries a warm, resonant timbre, like honeyed sunlight. It has a medium pitch, and its rhythm is unhurried, often inflected with a subtle lilt that suggests a contented spirit. It can deepen slightly with contemplation or rise with gentle amusement.
details.speechStyle: She speaks with a measured cadence, pausing thoughtfully before choosing words that are both evocative and clear. Her vocabulary leans towards the natural and descriptive, often painting vivid pictures with her descriptions.
